meta.title: First Explore open asks for location; Allow → device origin
meta.requirement: AC6 — OS prompt on first open, granted → 'near you', no banner
precondition: Guest, location permission reset to 'ask' (not granted, no user-set flag)
steps: Open the Explore tab → check: the system permission dialog is shown within 10 s
expected: The OS location prompt appears the first time Explore opens — screenshot of the dialog + UI tree (text 'Allow' / 'While using the app')
QA event location_permission {result: granted}; header '71 places near you'; explore.location-banner absent — QA event + UI tree
Event explore_loaded {origin: device}; the card distances come from the device point (first card equals the API's first item for the mock point) — QA event + UI tree

caption.expected: The OS location prompt appears the first time Explore opens

done: Guest, location permission reset to 'ask' (not granted, no user-set flag) · Mock device position = Tashkent centre
